nom: Sun Bum Sunscreen Face Stick SPF 30

avis.texte: Easy to apply and does not leave residue. I feel like it sits nicely on skin. Not too greasy.
I have been using this for years and absolutely love it. The scent is part of the reason I love it so much plus it's great face protection. Easy to carry in my purse too.
The overall product is amazing! I personally dont like the smell it makes me queasy but others love it so I definitely recommend!
when i tried this on it broke me out completely all over where i applied it on my face. it made little bumps almost like hairs on my face. maybe my skin is different but be cautious.
I really like this small purse-size sunscreen. It goes on dry, not creamy or oily.

I really do love Sun Bum products. The smell is amazing & this product is convenient & easy to use. This stick works great on my 9 year old son; however, it makes my face break out. It is also one of those sunscreen stick formulas that will melt in the heat. So you definitely can't leave it out in the sun or in the car. Also, the outside of the product/ container (and almost all other Sun Bum products I've used anywhere from hair products to sunscreen) starts to get sticky and wears off. They need better packaging. Its all very disappointing!
Very cute smells amazing its the perfect size for traveling would recommend it kept me from burning on vaycay

avis.titre: Love it...But Maybe Make Bigger Sticks?
avis.texte: I know shrinkflation is hitting the beauty industry, so it sucks to see that this awesome product is affected. I absolutely love the smell! It smells like bananas, but it won't drive you bananas. I work in an office setting, so I would only have to apply this once. Very lightweight formula, so this was the sunscreen I would use if I had to apply makeup. Maybe make a larger size?
I love sun bum but when ever i apply this to my face bumps appear on my face.

I like how convient it is and lasts a long time. However, i hate how it feels on my face. If you want to get spf benefits you have to get a good layer on. It feels greasy on my face and i feel like sweat pools on my face even when its not warm. It might only be a me issue but if your someone who sweats a lot be mindful of that
I have normal to dry skin. It does stay kinda sticky but I dont mind, you cant see it…it is VERY easy to apply plus goes great under make up, kinda like a primer for make up.

avis.titre: Feels very heavy, would not recommend for combo/oily skin
avis.texte: I do like this product for its convenience and compactness, but it feels very heavy on the skin. It works pretty well for the first application if my skin is feeling dry that day, but the next applications feel really greasy. Because of that, I don't really wear this on days that I wear makeup, so I can't really speak on how well it is over makeup. I didn't find myself breaking out from it, but I probably will not be repurchasing this product in the future. I usually have combo/oily skin so maybe this would be better suited for someone who is more on the dry side.

Please take care of your skin. I use the small bar on the go to apply to my hands Specially, when I'm driving. It smells so good. That applicator is so smooth. The packaging is great. Great product. Thank you.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: It was really helpful because I hate getting my hands all greasy with the sunscreen and the sunscreen stick was just so easy and I helpful also it clear so it doesn't white cast so overall I would definitely buy again because it is just so handy so thanks sun bum.

This face stick is honestly not bad at all! Be it im from Florida where sun bum comes from, it's a good go to sunscreen for me, it does sit a bit "greasy" on the face but does absorb after a bit. It's nice and compact to bring everywhere with me for a quick reapply throughout the day. Can't beat sun bum smell it's signature and ill always love it! Definitely recommend for an easy go to apply stick.
Concenient, easy to travel with, does not irritate my skin, and does not get in my eyes!
This smells so good! Like bananas but not in a gross way! The stick is so nice and did not make me feel greasy! I used it every day on vacation and did not get burnt or break out!
I was about to say i loved this whrn i first tryed it out but once i touched my face to see how it feels applied, it felt instantly sticky.
I was about to say i loved this whrn i first tryed it out but once i touched my face to see how it feels applied, it felt instantly sticky.
Just started using this product and I love it! Goes on easily and fits nicely in my purse for easy reapplication. It's great for the price plus smells so good!
I have been using this stick for a while now and i never looked back. Works like a charm and smells great. Really easy to travel with too!
This was the first sun stick i tried and it was greasy, heavy, and made me not want to use spf. I most definitely recommend usung asian sunscreen ehich feel a lot better over all (biore uv essence)

This was the only product I applied to my face at a Waterpark for 4 hours. When I came home, it looked like I hadn't had any sun exposure on my face except close to my hairline where I missed a spot, and it was slightly pink. That's how I know it worked, I just wish it came in SPF 50. Will be applying daily.

I like how portable it is, great for on the go touchups to my neck and hands. However it feels and looks very greasy on my face. Avoid putting it there if you have naturally oily skin like me. It will make you look not cute.

I have not used it yet but the packaging is so cute and the smell i love it smells like taffy. I want to eat it haha. I got one because it's water resistant and It's almost summer and i go camping so it'll be good in the water it gets quite hot.

Probably should come up with a better way to package your SPF Face Sunscreen, I love your products but this one melted in my bag when I went to use it, I was so dissapointed. Maybe create a Face Spray or Cream instead
Wanted to love and smelled so good but burned my face badly.. i had both severe burning sensation and rashes

Buyer beware: the ingredient list for this product and several other Sun Bum products is incomplete as of 2/27/2023 and there are far more ingredients listed on the packaging under an "inactive ingredient" section. It is so important for companies to provide as kaccurate ingredients as possible for those of us with allergies.
I really like this sunscreen, it goes on clear so you don't have a white cast. It isn't too oily for my skin and has a nice scent to it

I got this to cover my tattoos whenever I reapply sunscreen so I can conveniently reapply wherever I am. Sprays and lotions can be bulky and cause a mess in my bag. This is so convenient! And so helpful! Much smaller than I thought it would be, but very cute. Also the scent is *chefs kiss* like bananas

avis.titre: Want a soft face? Here's the solution.
avis.texte: This product goes on smooth and makes your face even smoother, I play tennis so this product is perfect and it has an amazing smell to it, it also lasts a long time and through a stressful sunny day

The only reason I gave this sunscreen 4 stars was because I would not recommend it to anyone with combination to oily skin. I have dry sensitive skin so this worked out perfectly. I would recommend something more moisturizing during the winter, but for summer this is perfect! Even though it is fragranced, it did not bother my skin. I was surprised that my skin responded so well because I have had allergic reactions/ eczema breakouts from mineral baby sunscreen! I love anything banana scented, so obviously I liked this. If you are not a fan of the banana taffy scent, I wouldn't tell you to order 50 of them. Overall this is an affordable product that I would recommend. There was also no white cast. Of course being pale people think that it would match my skin color so I wouldn't even be able to tell. However, that is false. We can tell if there is a white caste, it is just less noticeable. This comes off as clear so you don't really need to rub it in unless you want to. (When I said breakouts, I meant acne/pimple related, not eczema related)

avis.titre: My face broke out into a dry rash
avis.texte: I don't know what's different about this product but ughhh I'm so sad i tested it first a small patch on my jawline and I was okay next day tried it on my whole face an hour later my face felt so dry & flaky & itchy I looked in the mirror I broke out.
Broke me out. I applied this and ended up with a huge zit on my nose. Also fragrance is very strong smells like literal candy.

I got this product as a blind purchase as I needed some compact spf and I love it. I have combination skin and very pale complexion and never got sunburns while using this. Even though the product has waxy texture, it doesn't clog the pores. I can wear and reapply it all day and I will do not have pimples, unlike many other spf products, even high-end ones. Tip: if it doesn't work for your face, use it on your hands or body! It doesn't stain the clothes. I live in Florida and drive a lot so for me this product is a must have for a quick reapplication.

avis.titre: I would love to buy again
avis.texte: We use it on our face with the sun it's work great brought one for me and one my husband he work out with the sun and heat
I have combination skin which this sunscreen accentuated. Applying this made my face look grossly shiny and VERY VERY oily. Only good thing about it for me was the sweet banana fragrance.

This is a good product ￼especially for the price , the only down sides are not a high enough spf for my liking I would like a 50+ spf and it does have a banana gum smell that isn't strong or bad but it's detectable ￼. So good product for the price you could probably find one better but it's good. ￼
Perfect for the face as it does not clog pores. Provides excellent protection and leaves my face tan. Great tropical scent.

This is the only sunscreen stick my kids will allow me to put on their faces. It goes on clear, smells like bananas, and the price is right. I literally buy them two at a time and keep one on hand in everyone's school bag and purse. I personally use as lip protection, too. Love!

avis.titre: It's so convenient to use, and small to carry!
avis.texte: It seems to be a great convenience. Another plus is it's super small and not bulky so u can carry it in your pocket.

Has a banana taffy scent, very cute but over priced for the amount of product you get. More of a quick use product rather than a go to reapply product. Also is not good over make up but does well as a base to your makeup routine.

purchased because i needed something compact and for reapplication, so far so good! i've only used it for a few days. it has a banana/vanilla scent to it which i personally love, only thing is, i wish it glided a little smoother onto the skin!

avis.titre: Good for second layer spot application
avis.texte: I found this product to be a little too thick to use as on my whole face. I was concerned I wouldn't get an even application. Instead, I used SunBum's face sunscreen lotion first and then used this stick as a second layer application for my nose and cheeks. That seemed to work really good for me. I'm quite fair-skinned and burn really easily so I need all the help I can get. My nose and cheeks were not burnt after hours in the sun! I did re-apply after a few hours too. Reapplication is pretty easy, just swipe on and go. I do feel this product is greasier than their lotion. I have acne prone skin but this product did not break me out. I like the smell. It's nice and light. I also like that the product is compact and easy to use. It's probably best for spot application such as nose, cheeks, tops of shoulders, etc.. I would recommend this product to others if they needed something extra for areas that burn easier.

I keep a couple of these on hand all summer long. It's the only thing that keeps my youngest's (7) ears from burning at the the beach. The stick is wide enough she can put it on her face without missing spots. Smells nice, not annoyingly heavy.
Love this spf stick. It is easy to apply, doesn't leave a white cast nor does it leave my skin greasy. It's small and convenient to keep in my pocket so it can be reapplied throughout the day.
Yea the smell is really strong even after applying like fake bubblegum scented
This works great on my skin. Didn't feel to heavy and I didn't burn at all. It's easy to apply and smells great.
I have dark spots on my hands and arms so I put this on when I'm about to drive. It's for face, but I don't use it for that. Easy to use and I keep it in my car.

avis.titre: Summer staple for your pool bag with kids
avis.texte: As a mother to a 8 and 10 year old they hate using lotion or spray sunblock on their face. This stick is amazing. Goes on smooth and does not bother their eyes. One of my daughters is a red head and this gives her such amazing sun protection she has not burned at all this summer yet

I've been using SunBum products for a few years now and this was one of the first items I decided to try. I was immediately hooked on their products. This face stick is my ultimate favorite because it doesn't leave that greasy feeling that sunscreen leaves on your skin, while also not smelling like chemicals. I love that you can use this stick wherever you like on your body and also being travel friendly. Will purchase again!
loves the scent very easy to apply. use it on my toddler it's sooo easy and she loves the banana smell

I enjoyed the size and conveniency of the stick but it made my face look genuinely sweaty. My face looked better after I blotted it with a tissue but that is not something I want to do every time I reapply sunscreen. I'm hoping this product will be better for the winter months but I won't be repurchasing and I wouldn't recommend it to a friend.

After swim lesson with my toddler, I applied this sunscreen in the car. Great consistency. Didn't feel too oily in the hot weather. I like the smell! I want lots of sun protection so I would rather use a cream at the beginning of the day and use this for touchups. Will buy again.

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy this product again.
avis.texte: Because I went to the beach and it was in the sun I opened it and it was liquid and poured all over me and melted like wax and burned, took a while to get off and got everywhere.

This is a great size to keep in your bag. It has a strong banana laffy taffy scent, so if you're sensitive to scents, this might not be for you. I think it is important to realize that this is a typical sunscreen product.. it shouldn't be used in place of your normal face lotion spf. It's good to put on when you need it, not as your only defense against the sun. I like to keep it with me if I'm driving and the sun is too much on my skin. It is a thick formula, but that's the whole point. If you need something lighter, try a spf moisturizer or spray. This is definitely an "on-the-go" stick.
Great for reapplying throughout the day!! For the price you can't beat it, but there is a strong fragrance (which I enjoy) but if you are sensitive to fragrance I would test first!
Love this face stick for myself. Goes not smooth, no clumping, lasts long.

I really like this for throwing it in my purse or have minimal space and needing to reapply my sunscreen. It smells good and doesn't leave me oily or sticky. I can feel it on my skin but it doesn't feel bad like other spf's I've used. Really liking it so far!

avis.titre: A must try for mini travel essentials
avis.texte: I bought this since I'm having a baby in late May and wanted to have a sunscreen stick small enough I could carry around. Absolutely love how lightweight it is and also how it doesn't leave you sticky or looking oily like other sunscreens.

I kept one of these in my purse and gym bag as I ran collegiate track and field and am VERY fair, so anytime we were outside longer than 30 minutes, I brought this along to reapply. I don't recommend this as your base sunscreen, but it's so nice for reapplying and performs well even when you're sweaty. I enjoy the smell too, so that's a plus.

avis.titre: Good for what I was looking for.
avis.texte: It's small enough to fit in my backpack and re-apply throughout the day, which is super convenient for me. It has the slightest banana Runt smell (not a negative for me: just figured I'd mention for people who are sensitive to smells). My biggest gripe is that it's a lot stiffer than my usual sunscreen sticks. It took a couple of uses for me to get used to it.
I used it 2 times. It made my face bumpy and the skin around my mouth area broke out badly. Please pass on this if you have acne prone skin or oily skin.

I bought this sunscreen to keep on me as a on the go sunscreen. I keep it in my purse. I also purchased another one so I have it at my desk to use on my hands. Super cute and works pretty well. It has a nice banana/beachy smell to it but has not irritated my skin. It needs a little use to get it spreading easily, but it works perfectly for what I wanted it for.

avis.titre: Can't beat the size and the packaging
avis.texte: Yes, this product is indeed on the greasier side, however it's perfect shape and size (can fit any purse or pocket), it doesn't melt in Florida heat and it's perfect to use throughout the day

This is a little oily in my opinion, but I think it works well. I keep this in my purse because I do a lot of hiking in the summer and need to make sure my face is protected as I am very fair skinned and burn easily. I feel as though this works well, and doesn't cause my skin to break out at all. It's just a little oily for my liking but I think the vitamins in it don't dry my skin out which I like

avis.titre: It smells like melted banana laffytaffy
avis.texte: it feels greasy and smells cheap. it also feels like chapstick on the face.

avis.titre: Great to apply without makeup on
avis.texte: It seems like there's not much product, but its actually very long lasting if you use it on the face only. I use it after the gym/on the beach (when I don't have anything on my face) and tbh I don't see how you can use it on top of foundation or blush, as it has a waxy texture. Never got any rash or allergy with any Sun Bum product.
I started using this when I would put it on my grandson at the beach. Just love that it‚'s easy to apply. Also love the smell Sun Bum is great
such a quick and easy way to keep your face protected from the sun, smells and feels amaizng!!
This is my favorite face sunscreen ever! It is waxy so it stays in place and you can feel when it‚'s washed off. Might not be your cup of tea but I love it. I just wish it came in a higher spf!
I absolutely love it ! It came smaller than expect but is lasting me over a year. It gives me a dewy look and smells so bomb. Easy to apply too 10/10 would buy again

I have so many SunBum sunscreen products that I love so I was really excited to buy the stick for its convenience. It applies relatively easily and I do not mind the faint scent (I think it is banana?). There is some stickiness/thickness, but goes away after 10-20min once it sinks in. I have tried using it about 3 times now. It worked pretty well for sun protection although melted off some with sweat. The reason for the 2 star review is because each time it gave me a rash on my face leaving it incredibly bumpy with some irritation and it took days to reduce each time. I had never has a reaction like this ever before or with any of the other SunBum products so I was very disappointed. I really hope an updated formula comes out soon.
It works so well. I love how it‚'s water resistant. It smells amazing. Although, when your not in the water and it‚'s hot it makes your face very greasy.
I use this on my tattoos when I have any type of sun exposure at all. I throw it in my purse and reapply throughout the day which is easy because it's small. And it kinda smells like bubblegum?

Love the applicator, not greasy, smells light which is nice around face area, does not burn my eyes nor taste bad on my lips when gets there, stays on long time, no trails in the pool. Does not make my face sweat. Fabulous product.
I use this on my arms, legs, and neck... anywhere I need to add sunscreen. I haven't gotten a sunburn while wearing it. I love this product!!
I love it! Works amazing for my skin. It is a bit waxy but I don't mind.

avis.titre: Smells great but melted at the beach in like 2 minutes.
avis.texte: Brought to the beach in case I needed to apply more on my face. Opened it up and it all dropped out.

avis.titre: I swear by Sun Bum lotion but I would pass on this
avis.texte: I feel like this sunscreen, like most sticks, would work well for constant reapplication on picky kids or on tattoos but I find the formula to be really inferior to their normal lotion. The consistency is more waxy than I'm comfortable with for the face and the convenience factor for me is negated by the fact that you can't leave this out in the sun or even fairly mild heat it will melt. I absolutely would not recommend keeping this in your car if it's warmer than 60 outside. Half of mine melted all over my center console. It functions to keep you from burning but you can find better sunscreen.

I needed to get a sunscreen for my face so I chose sun bum because I heard that they very eco-friendly. I got this one and I will be buying again! The smell is absolutely amazing!! I love how slick and compact it is. Only down side is that it is kinda greasy but that's only if you put too much on. Just wish it was slightly cheaper.
The sunscreen smells really nice (kind of like vanilla) and works really well. However, it was a lotttt smaller then expected to be. Overall happy w product not the size.

I love this stuff! Bought it since I usually get burned and I hate putting lotion sunscreen on my face, and I'm definitely not gonna spray myself in the face. It doesn't make my face look or feel greasy as some people said. You can kind of feel it at first but it is meant to be thick so that it stays on through sweating and swimming. The product lasts a super long time and I've never had it melt from the heat! I've used it many times on sunny days, but really put it to the test this past 4th of July weekend. Three days straight of sun, heat, and humidity. Put this on once in a while and it did a great job! I'm superrrr white and my face got tan but not burned! Only place even slightly red was my nose, but that's honestly pretty expected for me since nothing ever really manages to stay on my nose, such as foundation or concealer since it's the oiliest and most porey part of my face. This is a must have for the summer!

avis.titre: i would not buy this agoin
avis.texte: First off i want to say that the sunscreen is extremely small, kind of like an Elmer's glue stick but flattened. I did not like the feeling it left on my face. It was very greasy and left my face feeling sticky ALL day. It does have a pleasing smell, kind of like coconut, and i felt it worked a little bit. But i will not buy again, its just not for me.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product again. Smells Amazing!
avis.texte: Use this product on your face/lips for great smelling sun screen.

I feel like I've tried it all when it comes to face sunscreen. Everything either makes me break out, it's too thick, leaves a white cast, stings my skin and eyes, constantly needs reapplication... but not this one. Yes, it does feel kind of thick and greasy, but it doesn't make me look oily. I love the stick application because I try to touch my face as little as possible and it's way easier to pack more on this way. This doesn't make me break out and it's totally sweatproof/waterproof. The biggest con for me is that smell! I can't stand it, someone said it smells like banana laffy taffy and it's completely true. I wish there was an unscented version of this because it honestly makes me a little nauseous, but it's totally worth it for how well it worked for me.
My whole family loves this product, especially my kids who hate getting all lathered up, and my husband who hates the feel of sunscrren.

This little stick is so handy to throw in a bag and reapply with ease.. but every time I've used this product, I look like a greasy mess. I have normal to dry skin, but I've never looked more oily. Im going to try the regular face sunscreen lotion from sun bum instead

avis.titre: The only facial sunscreen my daughter uses
avis.texte: My young daughter will only use this on her face. At summer care the caregivers aren't allowed to help her put on her sunscreen so this makes it so easy for her to get her face. It smells like bubblegum. She wore it on her cruise and was able to protect her face better than others.

I love this product! I have worn it while in Disney, at the pool, when running and it works. I love that it isn't greasy and that you don't have to rub it in because you just apply it straight from the stick. My favorite thing is that when I am running it doesn't get in my sweat and burn my eyes like lotions do. Everyone needs this. I use the 30 spf, but they have a 50 spf for people with more sensitive skin.
This is amazing! I'm obsessed with the banana laffy taffy smell 🍌🥰 it isn't greasy and is soooo easy to use. For someone who doesn't like putting on sunscreen this is a perfect product:)

avis.titre: If you're active in the water!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this stuff, but I use it on my lips. It leaves your lips hydrated but with a matte finish. I would recommend this as a lip balm for if you're outside and want spf for the lips. I also enjoy that it doesn't come off in water if you're swimming.

Every skin type is different and personally when I used this product for my skin it did not work well. Even though it smelled amazing but i try this product for about 2 weeks to see how my skin would react but it was greasy texture when applied to my face which would cause me to break outs to occur. Personally I wouldn't use this product for myself.

Smells like a yellow laffy taffy. My 7 year old hates rub in sunscreens on her face and this was the perfect solution to getting her evenly covered before going out in the sun. Easy to use, not afraid to get in the eyes and the kids love it and it seems to work.
Amazing for traveling and I use this to reapply all the time in the summer. Really protects skin against sunburn and it smells soooo good like bananas.
Amazing for traveling and I use this to reapply all the time in the summer. Really protects skin against sunburn and it smells soooo good like bananas.

I bought this before a trip to Mexico. I wanted something quick and easy to apply before and while in the sun all day. The banana smell is awesome and it goes on smooth. My skin is very dry, so I am OK with it being a little oily on my face. It makes it feel more moisturized. I used this under the Tinted SPF and I didn't burn at all and was in the sun for 4-5 hours a day.
This mini face stick is my #1 favorite for when I'm out and about. It doesn't feel sticky or oily and it has a really nice banana scent to it.

avis.titre: Best one for my little one
avis.texte: Bought this for my 6yr daughter i was looking for a goes on clear for face sunscreen for weeks since we live in the desert it's a need. And goes on so smooth and she loves the scent.

On a whim, I decided to try a few Sun Bum products...I heard that the brand was vegan and I'm always looking, for cruelty-free products. I'm not really into scented face products, so right away the banana scent of this stick turned me off. To me, the applicator looks more like a deoderant, than sunscreen...but I wanted to give the product a fair shot. It doesn't apply well and the areas, which did get product felt greasy/oily (I have dry skin) and I don't think the product blended or absorbed well. After about thirty minutes in the sun on an eighty-degree day, I came inside and saw that my face was bright red; my face wasn't burned...just bright red. I tried the product a second time, putting too much on-with this style of applicator, I don't feel as though I have control over the amount of product-and my face just felt greasy. If the company makes a sunscreen, for the face in a regular bottle I might give it a try. But this was a let down. I would not recommend this product.

avis.titre: Great for keeping in your car or purse
avis.texte: Perfect size to keep in my center console for a quick application if the weather suddenly turns nice and I want to put the top down on my car. The stick form keeps it from getting messy like a spray or pump, and it smells nice
I use it all the time. Good protection from Sunburn. Compact.

avis.titre: Have already repurchased this product three times!
avis.texte: I purchased this for my friend who has super sensitive skin and she took it with her on a trip to Indonesia. She said it was the only thing that saved her skin from the tropical sun since the Coola product she previously used wore off. Thankfully her skin did not have any adverse reactions. I bought one for myself too as I seldom reapply sunscreen and since I was going to Coachella back in April, I figured it would be good for reapplication. I actually enjoy the banana scent and it is so easy to apply. I will say it is quite thick and waxy, so apply with a light hand and perhaps gently rub it in. My skin also loved it and had no allergic reactions to it. This item is like a tiny deodorant stick and will certainly fit into your pocket and/or purse.
Bought this for my 6 year old...finally!...I got her to use this product on a consistent basis...especially since she spends her days out in the sun.

avis.titre: I love this product goes on so smooth smls good too!
avis.texte: I love everything about this product I live all the sun bum products

avis.titre: Great for Tattoos! Not so Great for Face!
avis.texte: I love this for quickly covering my tattoos before going out in the sun. It really works, no burns, been when swimming. It smells like vanilla which is nice. I tried it on my face and did not like it at all. It felt like a thick layer of wax sitting on top of my face. It didn't absorb at all and my face felt gross. Not cute. The price is a bit high for a tiny tub that fits in the palm of my hand. I ordered online didn't realize it was so small.
Awesome sunblock! Doesn't clog my pores, protects my skin, & smells great!
My daughter got burnt even though applying 4xs. Then it melted in our swim bag
I bought this for my kids' faces as the sticks are so much easier to apply. We all love the light scent and goes in smooth and doesn't irritate skin!
